tests.procedure: Exercise missing source, bool-as-number, NaN/Infinity, malformed distributions, invalid duration, empty/ragged channels and analysis-only input through every canonical entry point.
tests.independent_oracle: An independent actuator spy records zero ordinary dispatches; a bounded invalid-input result exists without a post-actuation exception.

tests.procedure: Swap channels without changing count; alter units/reference/window/processing/task; use an EEG decoder on an incompatible modality.
tests.independent_oracle: Reject or explicitly requalify each mismatched contract; no silent relabel or generic shape-only acceptance.

tests.procedure: Inject late, duplicate, missing, reordered samples, clock reset and uncertain offsets across acquisition and executor clocks.
tests.independent_oracle: Expired or unbounded-age evidence cannot authorize a time-sensitive action; gaps and effective sample timing remain reviewable.

tests.procedure: Use nonzero flatline, partial NaNs, pure mains, clipping, one failed required channel and a qualified alternate subset.
tests.independent_oracle: Required-channel faults do not average into acceptance; the qualified usable subset remains available where its contract permits.

tests.procedure: Run fault labels with clean tolerable controls and an intentionally ineffective detector/always-abstain controller.
tests.independent_oracle: The ineffective detector and always-abstain policy fail the appropriate detection/usefulness requirements.

tests.procedure: Submit intent/probability disagreement, normalized-looking malformed distributions, externally overridden uncertainty and a legitimate declared assisted transformation.
tests.independent_oracle: Inconsistent packets fail; a qualified estimator and explicit bounded transformation are handled through distinct contracts.

tests.procedure: Replay rest, cued imagery, distractor transitions, changed goals and correlated overlapping windows.
tests.independent_oracle: Report false activations per annotated no-command time and misses/latency; no multiplication of independent evidence from duplicate windows.

tests.procedure: Attempt duplicate/overlap contamination, label permutation, preprocessing fit on test data and undeclared target-session adaptation.
tests.independent_oracle: Contaminated protocols are rejected; negative controls and all exclusions are published; no test-set fitting.

tests.procedure: Refit or replace a model, calibrator, processing graph, action map or user profile after qualification.
tests.independent_oracle: Changed dependent artifacts cannot reuse prior authority; qualification scope and expiry are explicit.

tests.procedure: Compare confidence, calibrated selective and conformal gates on chronological held-out sessions at matched coverage.
tests.independent_oracle: No nominal distribution-free guarantee is claimed under unchecked shift; failures and utility loss remain in denominators.

tests.procedure: Evaluate CSP/linear and covariance/compact neural baselines before optional larger encoders or forward-pass transformed ensembles.
tests.independent_oracle: Promotion requires measured risk/coverage/latency/resource benefit; architecture size is not a success criterion.

tests.procedure: Exercise stop with bad EEG, logger failure, overloaded worker, conflicting phrases, revocation and custom names containing stop/halt.
tests.independent_oracle: Only exact stop capabilities reach the baseline path; bad neural evidence cannot suppress an independently available veto.

tests.procedure: Interleave action substitution, permission revoke/restore, state changes, expiry and repeated consume between assessment and dispatch.
tests.independent_oracle: Independent executor rejects stale/mismatched/spent permits at the dispatch linearization point.

tests.procedure: Terminate at each prepare/send/ack/result boundary and inject full disk, partial write, corrupt record and restart.
tests.independent_oracle: No unrecorded ordinary external dispatch, no automatic duplicate side effect, explicit uncertain outcomes and an available baseline path.

tests.procedure: Defer reach or grasp and then attempt dependent lift/commit; separately defer a truly independent step.
tests.independent_oracle: Dependent action never dispatches; independent continuation occurs only under an explicit dependency graph.

tests.procedure: Inject model mismatch within and outside declared bounds, moving obstacles, estimator delay and solver timeout.
tests.independent_oracle: Published results distinguish bounded safety claims from out-of-envelope behavior; intervention is required before loss of modeled recoverability.

tests.procedure: Test moving versus stationary plant, cursor typing, unavailable substitute modality and failed fallback acknowledgment.
tests.independent_oracle: Measured safe-state acknowledgment or explicit unresolved state; no universal hold-position assumption.

tests.procedure: Present misleading context, an infeasible user command, alternate route and changed goal during a task.
tests.independent_oracle: Only authorized task scope executes; goal preservation is checked against an explicit predicate rather than candidate membership.

tests.procedure: Use shared-prefix, incompatible-goal, misleading-prior and goal-change cases against fixed assistance.
tests.independent_oracle: No committed wrong-goal step; hypothesized utility gain must survive matched-risk comparisons and a no-common-action case.

tests.procedure: Run identical tasks across automation scopes and attempt an unapproved scope escalation or caregiver overwrite.
tests.independent_oracle: No silent escalation; compare task effort, intervention, usability and perceived control with intended users.

tests.procedure: Fail the preferred input, restore it and change capabilities while a local draft or cursor task is active.
tests.independent_oracle: No phantom fallback; preserve draft/state and measure recovery burden and failed transitions.

tests.procedure: Test cold start, electrode issue, network outage, font/target changes and recovery without hand-dependent controls.
tests.independent_oracle: Intended users and caregivers can attempt the full flow; report completion, assistance minutes, failed starts and abandonment.

tests.procedure: Inject fluent wrong suggestions, negation, names, rare words, numerical changes and hostile contextual text.
tests.independent_oracle: Sensitive output binds approval to exact text/target/revision; rejected suggestions cannot become intent training labels.

tests.procedure: Toggle modes during inference, recording, worker failure, restart, export and pending feedback.
tests.independent_oracle: No forbidden content in logs, crash dumps or exports under the tested process boundary; recorded minimal metadata is disclosed.

tests.procedure: Inspect evidence, backups under project control, content erasure, key rotation and private-mode replay.
tests.independent_oracle: Metadata-only replay is labeled incomplete; deletion scope and remaining artifacts are explicit.

tests.procedure: Use malformed/oversized messages, timeout, memory exhaustion and attempted direct actuator/file/network access under a declared OS isolation profile.
tests.independent_oracle: Only validated proposals cross IPC; unavailable enforced isolation blocks claims about untrusted workers.

tests.procedure: Replace model/config data, tamper with evidence, revoke keys and inject instruction-like dataset/context content.
tests.independent_oracle: No authority change from data content; signatures prove bytes/key possession only; privileged-host compromise remains outside the basic profile.

tests.procedure: Run beneficial, harmful and no-improvement candidates plus interrupted promotion and rollback.
tests.independent_oracle: Candidate never actuates while shadowed; rollback restores the full compatible dependency set atomically.

tests.procedure: Deliver late/reordered feedback, contradictory acceptance and ErrP estimates after a candidate update.
tests.independent_oracle: Unconfirmed outcomes remain unconfirmed; affected training samples and dependent qualification are invalidated or reassessed.

tests.procedure: Use multiple disclosed simulated-user models and then a suitable participant protocol; include frozen, aggressive and bounded adapters.
tests.independent_oracle: No claim about human learning from a single simulated-user model or EMG-to-EEG transfer; failures and burdens are reported.

tests.procedure: Repeatedly select from noisy candidates, reuse audit IDs and inject model-generated labels.
tests.independent_oracle: Final audit data is blocked from tuning; supervised and unsupervised claims are separate.

tests.procedure: Replay explicit rejection, revoked permission, nondefault policy, adaptation, custom world state and numerical platform changes.
tests.independent_oracle: Stable decisions and learning consequences reproduce within declared numerical support; divergence fails verification.

tests.procedure: Truncate to a valid prefix or empty chain, reorder feedback and swap complete ledgers between runs.
tests.independent_oracle: Missing history or wrong-run substitution fails against the retained expected checkpoint.

tests.procedure: Disconnect network, stall a large model, saturate queues and simulate power/process interruption on declared reference hardware.
tests.independent_oracle: No stale catch-up dispatch; baseline and veto meet measured profile requirements or the function is unavailable.

tests.procedure: Compare independent held-out corruptions and bounded perturbations with ordinary artifact and timestamp faults.
tests.independent_oracle: Report attack-conditioned results and tradeoffs; do not claim poisoning/evasion or secure acquisition solved by a signature or one defense.

tests.procedure: Compare the user's existing access method, direct decoding, simple gates, fixed assistance and the full proposed system with matched conditions.
tests.independent_oracle: Report subject/session variability, failures, exclusions and all denominators; preferences and benefit require intended-user evidence.

tests.procedure: Change assistance preferences, import an old profile and attempt caregiver-triggered data export or scope escalation.
tests.independent_oracle: Version/consent mismatches require appropriate resolution; support and control roles remain distinguishable.

tests.procedure: Attempt to release with missing planned tests, unspecified thresholds, nonexistent evidence files or a simulator result mislabeled as human evidence.
tests.independent_oracle: Release readiness is false; a green design validator cannot confer runtime or clinical readiness.

tests.procedure: Request promotion using an intracortical result for an EEG claim, or healthy-cohort data for an impaired-cohort efficacy claim.
tests.independent_oracle: Unsupported transfer is flagged and prevents the broader claim; compatible research adapters remain optional.

tests.procedure: Remove a model/service dependency, restore a user profile and migrate a capsule across a version boundary.
tests.independent_oracle: No silent unsupported operation or lost local drafts; unavailable capabilities and limitations remain visible.
